title: Utility-payment difficulty coexists with more balance carrying and less savings, but access differs by resources
source_unit: 2025 SIPP public-use file, 2024 reference year; person records by reference month

observations.period: 2024 reference year; joint utility, credit, and savings universe

denominator.unit: valid person-record/month rows with valid household status and utility-payment field

utility_difficulty_group_carried_credit_.unit: person-weighted percent among utility-difficulty rows with nonblank credit field

no_utility_difficulty_group_carried_cred.unit: person-weighted percent among no-difficulty rows with nonblank credit field

utility_difficulty_group_owned_savings_a.unit: person-weighted percent among utility-difficulty rows with nonblank savings field

no_utility_difficulty_group_owned_saving.unit: person-weighted percent among no-difficulty rows with nonblank savings field

observations.method: Weighted joint diagnostic using WPFINWGT and 240 replicate weights with Census Fay-BRR (G=240, perturbation factor 0.5); EAWBGAS code 1 versus 2 within the valid official utility universe, with EDEBT_CC and EOWN_SAV each retaining their nonblank field universes.
observations.uncertainty: Approximate Fay-BRR intervals quantify sampling-design uncertainty for the person-record diagnostic. Person records repeat household fields, so the result is not a household-prevalence estimate and cannot establish timing or causality.
observations.subgroup: Person-record/month rows reporting utility-payment difficulty versus no reported difficulty.
observations.counterinterpretation: Higher balance carrying among utility-difficulty rows is consistent with credit smoothing, but lower savings may also limit credit access; the joint pattern does not identify the direction of the relationship.

observations.period: 2024 reference year; utility-difficulty subgroup by monthly income-to-poverty ratio

denominator.unit: utility-difficulty person-record/month rows with positive weight; subgroup cells retain their own nonblank denominators

observations.method: WPFINWGT joint diagnostic among valid utility-difficulty rows, stratified by THINCPOV bands, with 240 replicate weights and Census Fay-BRR variance; credit and savings outcomes use their own nonblank denominators.
observations.uncertainty: Approximate Fay-BRR intervals quantify sampling-design uncertainty for the person-record cells; income-to-poverty ratio is monthly and does not equal liquid cash, debt capacity, or a dated bill shock.
observations.subgroup: Utility-difficulty rows below 1x, 1–1.99x, 2–3.99x, and 4x-or-more monthly income-to-poverty ratio.
observations.counterinterpretation: The higher balance-carrying share at higher resources within the utility-difficulty group is a counterexample to reading balance carrying as a simple deprivation scale; lower-resource respondents may have less access to revolving credit.

related_sources.claim: Official field labels, status flags, and universe documentation.

boundary: This is a person-weighted SIPP joint diagnostic, not a household-weighted causal estimate. It shows co-occurrence of utility-payment difficulty, credit-card balance carrying, savings-account ownership, and resource bands within the selected monthly records. It does not identify a dated bill, rate, lender decision, payment outcome, remedy, trust, political action, or the same household's full trajectory.
